pages.text: The hill is steep. Yara gets hot and her legs hurt.
Fizz flaps his wings. Flap, flap, flap! Then Fizz is up in the air!
pages.picture: baby dragon flying for the first time

pages.text: At the top, the big dragon gets up. Her wings are as big as a ship.
pages.picture: a huge mother dragon standing up

pages.text: "Mum!" said Fizz. The big dragon hugs him with her tail.
pages.picture: mother dragon hugging baby with her tail

pages.text: Then the big dragon looks at Yara. "Thank you for this," she said. "Get on my back."
pages.picture: mother dragon inviting the girl onto her back

pages.text: Yara and Fizz and Mum zoom up into the night. The moon is big. The stars are bright.
pages.picture: girl riding a dragon under the moon and stars
the dragons and girl silhouetted against the moon
